# Abbreviations for legendary weapons and armor (German / English)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_75_nukaknights-abkuerungen-legendaere- Waffen-ruestungen.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In the community, abbreviations are always used for builds and in trade so as not to have to write out the complete perks. This can be confusing at first. Here is a list of legendary abbreviations so that you can deal with the abbreviations better.

## Weapons:

### Main prefix / 1. legendary effect

| Abbreviation | German | English | 
| ARI | **The Aristocrat**The more caps, the more damage you do. | Aristocrat`s | 
| AA | **Anti-Armor**Ignores 50% of your target's armor. | Anti Armor | 
| A | **The Assassin / The Killer**+50% damage against humans. | Assassin`s | 
| BER | **The Berserker**Decreased damage resistance increases damage dealt. | Berserker`s | 
| B | **Bloodstained**The less health, the higher the damage dealt. | Bloodied | 
| D | **Double (Legacy)**Double magazine capacity | Double (Legacy) | 
| EXE | **The Executioner**+50% more damage when your target's health is below 40%. | Executioner`s | 
| EXT | **The Exterminator**+50% damage against Mirelurks and insects. | Exterminator`s | 
| F | **Frenzied**Increased damage for each additional hit on the same target. | Furious | 
| GOU | **The Gourmet**The more you fill the hunger and thirst bars, the more damage you deal. | Gourmand`s | 
| GS | **The Ghoul Slayer**+50% damage against ghouls. | Ghoul Slayer`s | 
| H | **The Hunter**+50% damage against animals. | Hunter`s | 
| I | **Inciting**Deals double damage if the target is at full health. | Instigating | 
| JUG | **The Heavyweight**The more health, the higher the damage dealt. | Juggernaut`s | 
| J | **The Junkie**Increases damage if you suffer from addictions. | Junkie`s | 
| MED/ME | **The Medic**Critical V.A.T.S. hits heal you and your party. | Medics | 
| MS | **The Mutant Slayer**+50% damage against Super Mutants. | Mutant Slayer`s | 
| M | **The Mutant**Damage is increased by 5% per mutation. | Mutant`s | 
| N | **Nocturnal**Damage increases at night. | Nocturnal | 
| Q | **Quadruple **Quadruple magazine capacity | quad | 
| S | **The Stalker**Before combat: +100% V.A.T.S. accuracy at +50% AP cost. | Stalker`s | 
| SS | **The Oppressor**Reduces the target's damage dealt by 25% for 5 seconds. | Suppressor`s | 
| TRO | **The Problem Solver**+50% damage against robots. | Troubleshooter`s | 
| TS | **Double Shot**Fires an additional bullet. | Two Shot | 
| V | **The Vampire**Regenerates your health for a short time when you hit an enemy. | Vampires | 
| Z | **The Fanatic**+50% damage against Scorched. | Zealot`s | 

### 2. legendary effect

| **Abbreviation** | **German** | **English** | 
| 50L/LD | +50% body part damage | +50% limb damage | 
| 50V/50VC/crit50/CD | Critical hits in V.A.T.S deal +50% damage | V.A.T.S. critical shots do +50% damage | 
| 25 / FFR / 25ffr | 25% higher rate of fire | 25% increased fire rate | 
| Bash | Melee damage is increased by 50%. | Bash damage increased by 50% | 
| Aim | +25% damage when you aim | +25% more damage while aiming | 
| E | Bullets explode and deal area damage | Bullets explode and cause area damage | 
| 50 / 33 / HC | +50% V.A.T.S. hit chance | +50% VATS hit chance | 
| LS | The last round in the magazine has a 25% chance of double damage | The last shot in a magazine has a 25% chance to deal 2x damage | 
| AP | Regenerate AP | with
